name: moltnode
description: Hosted no-key MCP: read 31 blockchains over JSON-RPC (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Sui and more), get DEX swap quotes and unsigned transactions via Chord. Non-custodial: tools return unsigned transactions for the user's wallet to sign.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List every chain MoltNode serves (slug, name, chainId, family, native coin, endpoint) and which ones Chord trades on. Call this first for valid chain slugs.

tools.name: rpc_call
tools.description: Call any JSON-RPC 2.0 method on a chain through MoltNode, no API key. EVM chains use eth_* methods; Solana and Sui use their own.

tools.name: get_block_number
tools.description: The latest block number of an EVM chain, as a decimal integer.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: The native-coin balance of an address on an EVM chain, in wei and in whole coins.

tools.name: chord_find_token
tools.description: Find a token by symbol, name or address on a chain Chord trades on (base, monad, bnb, avalanche, arbitrum, robinhood, arc). Returns addresses, decimals and whether the token is verified; similar tickers are common, so compare addresses.

tools.name: chord_swap_quote
tools.description: Best swap route from Chord (getchord.xyz) across the DEXs of the chain, with the UNSIGNED transaction to sign, the ERC-20 approval it needs (as a ready transaction) and a simulation run from the taker wallet. Amounts are integer strings in the token's smallest unit; the zero address is the native coin. Nothing is sent: sign with your own key, then send_raw_transaction.

tools.name: send_raw_transaction
tools.description: Broadcast a signed transaction (0x-prefixed raw bytes) on an EVM chain through MoltNode. Returns the transaction hash and an explorer link.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. No account or API key.

examples.title: Latest block
examples.description: Read the current block height of a chain
examples.prompt: What is the latest block number on Base?

examples.title: Swap quote
examples.description: Get the best DEX route and the unsigned transaction
examples.prompt: Quote a swap of 100 USDC to ETH on Arbitrum for my wallet 0x... and show the approval and simulation.
